questions: dependenceDomainOn after DEC-198. With the definition in Causal.Causality, C.dependenceDomainOn W S and C.dependenceDomain W S are the same notion under two names in one namespace (rfl, Probe.lean). The dispatch says 'redirect', DEC-198 says nothing on it. Reading taken: redirected, kept as a non-deprecated abbrev with its three lemmas, since the ladder's witnesses (programme/ladder.toml:3691, :3780) and the ERS statements name it. Deprecating it in favour of dependenceDomain (and its three lemmas in favour of the Causality ones) would be a further rename for the author to rule on.

The definition's alias is an abbrev (reducible), so a term written with the old name unfolds to the new one at reducible transparency; the renamed definition itself stays a semireducible def, as it was. Batteries' `alias` would give a semireducible alias. Reading taken: abbrev, the friendlier alias for any old user (there is none in the hub). Say if you want a plain def.
kb_proposals: A rename across namespaces is checked like a hoist (kb/0063) with the renamed prefixes substituted back inside every type and value (Expr.replace on .const): campaign/T-abs-dependence-domain-home/scratch/DumpSubst.lean and dump_subst_cmp.py. Set aside only the new deprecated aliases (deprecated AND named as a renamed constant's old name): the library already has deprecated constants (E0GX.*, the auto-deprecated *.toCtorIdx).

Write a deprecated alias as `@[deprecated New (since := ...)] theorem|abbrev Old ... := New`, the library's form (Port/E0GXStructure), not Batteries `alias`: tools/ledger.py's declared_names and tools/ladder.py's lean_index match theorem/def/abbrev/... and not `alias`, so an `alias`-ed old name would stop resolving in a ledger or the ladder.

After renaming X out of a namespace N with a deprecated alias N.X, every unqualified X inside N resolves to the alias, an error under warningAsError: re-point to dot notation ((minkowski d).dependenceDomain ⊤ S, the same length as dependenceDomain (minkowski d) ⊤ S) or to the new namespace (Causality.mem_dependenceDomain).

At Lean v4.31 the deprecation warning for a target in another namespace adds a paragraph 'Note: The updated constant is in a different namespace. Dot notation may need to be changed (...)'; a #guard_msgs must include it. The API to test deprecation in a script is Lean.Linter.isDeprecated env n.
